children: President Donald Trump has announced that he has offered the position of White House press secretary to Dana White, head of the Ultimate Fighting Championshp.

Trump made the announcement on social media while at his golf club in Florida, referring to White as “the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior,” and stating that he had requested White bring several UFC fighters as assistants.
Trump said, “We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left. Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other. Dana, please take the job!”
White, who was in London for a boxing event when the announcement was made, stated at a news conference that he planned to fly to Washington and meet with Trump at the White House on Monday.

When asked about how he would balance the potential new role with his existing commitments, White acknowledged, “Yeah, I got a lot of jobs already,” and declined to comment further on his discussions with Trump, indicating he may have more to say after their meeting.
Prior to his news conference, White shared Trump’s post on Instagram, paired with an image of himself standing at the White House press briefing podium, adding the message, “On to the next chapter.”

The press secretary position has been vacant since Karoline Leavitt left at the end of August. Trump’s administration is currently undergoing significant changes, including the recent replacement of his longtime adviser Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller as chief of staff following the Republican Party's losses in the recent midterm elections.

The White House and a UFC spokesperson did not immediately respond to requests from the AP for comment regarding the offer. Trump and White have maintained a longstanding friendship, with Trump attending several UFC events since returning to the White House in January 2025.
The Associated Press contributed to this report.

title: Trump offers press secretary position to UFC boss Dana White
